title: Adaptive hydraulic cache capacity and correctness semantics
question: Does the bounded adaptive-hydraulic cache remain a pure optimization when MultiSWAP encounters more unique hydraulic parameterizations than cache slots?

current_code_observation.full_cache_miss_path: b110_ahl_get_or_build returns ok=false when no free slot exists
current_code_observation.risk: the 33rd unique parameterization may fail solely because the performance cache is full

stage_1.workload: 40 sequential unique default-MvG parameterizations through a fresh local cache

repair_rule.required_semantics: cache capacity must never be a correctness limit
repair_rule.minimum_repair: on a full-cache miss, build a valid uncached table and return ok=true rather than failing
repair_rule.optional_eviction: not introduced unless separately justified by measured repeated over-capacity workloads
